aasmano aur zameen mein jo cheez bhi hai , woh Allah ki tasbeeh kerti hai jo badshah hai baray taqadduss ka malik hai , jiss ka iqtidar bhi kamil hai , jiss ki hikmat bhi kamil .

wohi hai jiss ney ummi logon  mein unhi mein say aik Rasool ko bheja jo unn kay samney uss ki aayaton ki tilawat keren , aur unn ko pakeezah banayen , aur unhen kitab aur hikmat ki taleem den , jabkay woh iss say pehlay khuli gumrahi mein parray huye thay ,
aur ( yeh Rasool jinn ki taraf bhejay gaye hain ) unn mein kuch aur bhi hain jo abhi unn kay sath aa-ker nahi milay .   aur woh baray iqtidar wala , bari hikmat wala hai .
yeh Allah ka fazal hai , woh jissay chahta hai deta hai , aur Allah baray fazal wala hai .

jinn logon  per toraat ka bojh daala gaya , phir unhon ney iss ka bojh nahi uthaya ,   unn ki misal uss gadhay ki si hai jo boht si kitaben laadey huye ho . boht buri misal hai unn logon  ki jinhon ney Allah ki aayaton ko jhutlaya , aur Allah aesay zalim logon  ko hidayat tak nahi phonchata .

. ( aey payghumber ! inn say ) kaho kay :  aey logo jo yahudi ban gaye ho ! agar tumhara dawa yeh hai kay saray logon  ko chorr ker tum hi Allah kay dost ho , to moat ki tamanna kero , agar tum sachay ho .
aur unhon ney apney haathon jo aemal aagay bhej rakhay hain , unn ki wajeh say yeh kabhi moat ki tamanna nahi keren gay , aur Allah inn zalimon ko khoob janta hai .

kaho kay :  jiss moat say tum bhagtay ho , woh tum say aa-milney wali hai , phir tumhen uss ( Allah ) ki taraf lotaya jaye ga jissay tamam posheeda aur khuli hoi baaton ka poora ilm hai , phir woh tumhen bataye ga kay tum kiya kuch kiya kertay thay .
aey emaan walo ! jab jumaa kay din namaz kay liye pukara jaye to Allah kay ziker ki taraf lapko , aur kharido farokht chorr do .   yeh tumharay liye behtar hai , agar tum samjho .
phir jab namaz poori hojaye to zameen mein muntashir hojao , aur Allah ka fazal talash kero ,   aur Allah ko kasrat say yaad kero , takay tumhen falah naseeb ho .

aur jab kuch logon  ney koi tijarat ya koi khel dekha to uss ki taraf toot parray , aur tumhen kharra huwa chorr diya .   keh do kay :  jo kuch Allah kay paas hai , woh khel aur tijarat say kahen ziyada behtar hai , aur Allah sabb say behtar rizq denay wala hai .
